pages.text: The Speed Upgrade increases the processing speed of machines. Each upgrade installed will reduce the time between operations.
Features:$(li)Reduces processing time$(li)Can be stacked for greater effect$(li)Works in machines like Importers, Exporters, and Constructors$(li)Increases power consumption
To use the Speed Upgrade:$(li)Right-click on a compatible machine$(li)Insert the upgrade into an upgrade slot$(li)Multiple upgrades can be installed$(li)Each upgrade will increase power consumption
